get_dataset_constants: get dataset constants like properties, num_channels, num_classes, variance, and image_size for a named dataset
is_disentanglement_dataset: check if a dataset name is one of the supported disentanglement datasets like shapes3d or dsprites
load_dataset: load a dataset using a config loader and return a generator of batched numpy arrays
transpose_fn: transpose a batch dictionary image tensor from NHWC to NCHW layout for TPU performance
resize: resize a batch of images to a target height and width using bilinear interpolation with JAX
